short.q: Explain what it means to listen for the gist of a text.
short.answer: It means listening for the main idea, such as who is speaking and what is happening, without needing every word.
short.working: 1 mark for the main idea, 1 mark for not needing every word.

short.q: Unscramble the words: SICHT and TETB. Write them with their articles.
short.answer: der Tisch, das Bett.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with article.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: cake, candle, present.
short.answer: der Kuchen, die Kerze, das Geschenk.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

short.q: Write a four-line dialogue in German between two friends who meet in the morning and say goodbye.
short.answer: A: Guten Morgen, Amina! B: Guten Morgen, Otieno! Wie geht's? A: Gut, danke. B: Tschüss!
short.working: 1 mark for each correct line with capital letters and punctuation.

short.q: Make a playful food blend from Mango and Milch, and say what it is.
short.answer: For example: Mangmil, a mango and milk drink.
short.working: 1 mark for a sensible blend, 1 mark for the explanation.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: family, cabbage or kale, toilet, fog, bed.
short.answer: die Familie, der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel, das Bett.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

short.q: Explain how a Rückendiktat is done.
short.answer: A partner traces letters on your back; you say the letters aloud and write the word.
short.working: 1 mark for each of the steps: tracing, saying, writing.

short.q: Read: "Mein Vater heißt Juma. Er ist groß und nett." Write three facts from the text in English.
short.answer: The father is called Juma. He is tall. He is kind.
short.working: 1 mark for each fact.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: arm, sister.
short.answer: der Arm, die Schwester.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Say what "Zum Frühstück trinke ich Tee" means in English.
short.answer: For breakfast I drink tea.
short.working: 1 mark for breakfast, 1 mark for drink tea.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandfather, plate.
short.answer: der Opa, der Teller.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Write these numbers in German: 5, 8, 13.
short.answer: fünf, acht, dreizehn.
short.working: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

short.q: Write three sentences in German that say where things are in your room.
short.answer: For example: Das Bett ist an der Wand. Der Tisch ist neben dem Bett. Die Tasche ist unter dem Tisch.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: mouth, door.
short.answer: der Mund, die Tür.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Write three German sentences that say where things are in a house, using im or in der.
short.answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

short.q: Read: "In Mombasa ist es heiß." Say what it means and how to say heiß.
short.answer: In Mombasa it is hot. heiß is said like hice.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Explain the trick to decide between ie and ei when you write.
short.answer: If you hear ee, write ie; if you hear eye, write ei.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Complete with the correct verb form: "Mutter ___ (kochen). Vater ___ (lesen). Der Hund ___ (schlafen)."
short.answer: kocht, liest, schläft.
short.working: 1 mark for each verb form.

short.q: Write two sentences in German to say where family members are at home.
short.answer: For example: Mama ist in der Küche. Papa ist im Wohnzimmer.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct in der / im.

short.q: Read and translate: "Wo ist der Ball? Er ist im Garten."
short.answer: Where is the ball? It is in the garden.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: hand, bread, maize.
short.answer: die Hand, das Brot, der Mais.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Explain why breaking a long word into parts helps you read it. Use Donnerstag as an example.
short.answer: Small parts are easier to say, for example Don-ners-tag.
short.working: 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for the example.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: face, father.
short.answer: das Gesicht, der Vater.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: sofa, bathroom, potato, milk, finger.
short.answer: das Sofa, das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch, der Finger.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

short.q: Write the plural of Auge, Hand and Zahn in German.
short.answer: die Augen, die Hände, die Zähne.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct plural.

short.q: A child arrives at school in the morning. Write in German what the child says to the teacher, and how the teacher asks how the child is, and the child's answer.
short.answer: Guten Morgen! Wie geht's? Gut, danke.
short.working: 1 mark for Guten Morgen, 1 mark for Wie geht's?, 1 mark for Gut, danke, 1 mark for capital letters and punctuation.

short.q: Write the German greetings for "good morning" and "good evening".
short.answer: Guten Morgen and Guten Abend.
short.working: 1 mark for each greeting spelled correctly.

short.q: Rewrite correctly: "guten abend otieno"
short.answer: Guten Abend, Otieno!
short.working: 1 mark for capital letters and 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Unscramble and write with der or die: STWECHERS.
short.answer: die Schwester.
short.working: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the article.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: bed, birthday, banana.
short.answer: das Bett, der Geburtstag, die Banane.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Write the ordinal numbers for first, second and third in German.
short.answer: der erste, der zweite, der dritte.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write in German: "I have two ears."
short.answer: Ich habe zwei Ohren.
short.working: 1 mark for Ich habe zwei and 1 mark for Ohren.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: candle, sky, cooker, knife.
short.answer: die Kerze, der Himmel, der Herd, das Messer.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: song, juice, egg.
short.answer: das Lied, der Saft, das Ei.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Write two German sentences about what you would like to do on your birthday.
short.answer: For example: Ich möchte tanzen. Ich möchte Kuchen essen.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

short.q: Write three steps you follow to understand a German text.
short.answer: Look at the title and pictures; read once for the gist; read again for details and answers.
short.working: 1 mark for each step.

short.q: Write the German names of these months: April, May, June.
short.answer: April, Mai, Juni.
short.working: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

short.q: Write the German names of these months: October, November, December.
short.answer: Oktober, November, Dezember.
short.working: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

short.q: Write three healthy foods and two unhealthy foods in German.
short.answer: Healthy: Obst, Gemüse, Bohnen. Unhealthy: Süßigkeiten, Limonade.
short.working: 1 mark for three healthy foods, 1 mark for two unhealthy foods, 1 mark for correct spelling.

short.q: Give two reasons why imitating a teacher or a recording helps when learning German sounds.
short.answer: We hear the right sounds and practise them again and again, so our mouth learns them.
short.working: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

short.q: Give two reasons why fruit and vegetables are good for the body.
short.answer: They give vitamins and energy; they help us to stay healthy.
short.working: 1 mark for each reason.

short.q: Write in German: "Today is Wednesday. Tomorrow is Thursday."
short.answer: Heute ist Mittwoch. Morgen ist Donnerstag.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: bathroom, potato, milk.
short.answer: das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: supper, shower, bean, fork.
short.answer: das Abendessen, die Dusche, die Bohne, die Gabel.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: fork, wall.
short.answer: die Gabel, die Wand.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Fill the gaps: "Das Buch ist ___ dem Tisch. Die Katze ist ___ dem Stuhl." Use auf and unter.
short.answer: auf; unter.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Read: "Heute ist Samstag. Vater liest im Wohnzimmer. Mutter kocht in der Küche." Give the gist.
short.answer: It is Saturday. Father is reading in the living room and Mother is cooking in the kitchen.
short.working: 1 mark for each of the three facts.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: snow, brother, meat.
short.answer: der Schnee, der Bruder, das Fleisch.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Write three sentences about what you do on three different days. Start each with "Am".
short.answer: For example: Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule. Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball. Am Sonntag gehe ich in die Kirche.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence with a capital letter, verb in second place and a full stop.

short.q: Say why we practise tongue twisters when learning to pronounce German.
short.answer: They repeat similar sounds, so the tongue and lips learn to move clearly and smoothly.
short.working: 1 mark for repeated sounds and 1 mark for clear speech.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear.
short.answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: knee, garden.
short.answer: das Knie, der Garten.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Give two safety rules for sending messages online.
short.answer: Write only to people you know; do not share private information; ask an adult first.
short.working: 1 mark for each rule.

short.q: List three members of the wider family in German with their articles.
short.answer: For example: die Oma, der Opa, der Onkel, die Tante.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article.

short.q: Read: "Er hat schwarze Haare und braune Augen." Say what it means.
short.answer: He has black hair and brown eyes.
short.working: 1 mark for hair, 1 mark for eyes.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: lamp, tomato.
short.answer: die Lampe, die Tomate.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Give three tips for reading a tongue twister well.
short.answer: Read slowly at first; add a few words at a time; speed up only when it is clear.
short.working: 1 mark for each sensible tip.

short.q: Write the seven days of the week in German in order, starting with Monday.
short.answer: Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag, Sonntag.
short.working: 4 marks for all seven correct; lose 1 mark for every two errors.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: cocoa, party.
short.answer: der Kakao, die Party.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Write these numbers in German: 2, 6, 10.
short.answer: zwei, sechs, zehn.
short.working: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: mother, rainbow, hair.
short.answer: die Mutter, der Regenbogen, das Haar.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: party, foot, head, daughter.
short.answer: die Party, der Fuß, der Kopf, die Tochter.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandmother, clock.
short.answer: die Oma, die Uhr.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with their articles for: fridge, cooker, plate, spoon.
short.answer: der Kühlschrank, der Herd, der Teller, der Löffel.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

short.q: Write a sentence in German that tells in which month your birthday is.
short.answer: For example: Ich habe im Mai Geburtstag.
short.working: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for a correctly spelled month.

short.q: Write a sentence about your favourite room in German.
short.answer: For example: Mein Lieblingszimmer ist die Küche.
short.working: 1 mark for the sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.

short.q: Write the German words with their articles for: rice, milk, egg, banana.
short.answer: der Reis, die Milch, das Ei, die Banane.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

short.q: Unscramble and write with the article: FELPA and SERI.
short.answer: der Apfel and der Reis.
short.working: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: fish, living room, rain.
short.answer: der Fisch, das Wohnzimmer, der Regen.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Unscramble the letters TAGFIRE to make a day of the week.
short.answer: Freitag.
short.working: 1 mark for the correct word and 1 mark for the capital letter.

short.q: Explain how the umlaut changes the word Hand in the plural.
short.answer: a becomes ä, so die Hand becomes die Hände.
short.working: 1 mark for the vowel change and 1 mark for the plural.

short.q: Write these numbers in German: 14, 16, 18.
short.answer: vierzehn, sechzehn, achtzehn.
short.working: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

short.q: Write a short weather report in German with a greeting, weather and a goodbye.
short.answer: For example: Guten Morgen! Heute ist es sonnig und warm. Es ist nicht windig. Tschüss!
short.working: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for weather sentences, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for the goodbye.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: head, eye, mouth, hand.
short.answer: der Kopf, das Auge, der Mund, die Hand.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: shower, bean.
short.answer: die Dusche, die Bohne.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: shoulder, son.
short.answer: die Schulter, der Sohn.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: plate, lamp, tomato, knee.
short.answer: der Teller, die Lampe, die Tomate, das Knie.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back, sugar, child.
short.answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken, der Zucker, das Kind.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: present, aunt, mango.
short.answer: das Geschenk, die Tante, die Mango.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Write the singular and plural of Fuß in German.
short.answer: der Fuß, die Füße.
short.working: 1 mark for each form.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: tummy, apple, cheese.
short.answer: der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

short.q: Write the four punctuation marks with their German names.
short.answer: . der Punkt, , das Komma, ? das Fragezeichen, ! das Ausrufezeichen.
short.working: 1 mark for each mark with its name.

short.q: Write these numbers in German: 4, 9, 12.
short.answer: vier, neun, zwölf.
short.working: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

short.q: Write in German: "The lamp is next to the bed."
short.answer: Die Lampe ist neben dem Bett.
short.working: 1 mark for the sentence pattern and 1 mark for neben dem Bett.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: toe, song, juice, egg, water.
short.answer: der Zeh, das Lied, der Saft, das Ei, das Wasser.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

short.q: Write in German: "The sun is shining."
short.answer: Die Sonne scheint.
short.working: 1 mark for Die Sonne and 1 mark for scheint.

short.q: Write the forms of "haben" for ich, du and er.
short.answer: ich habe, du hast, er hat.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct form.

short.q: Write the German words with der, die or das for: sky, cooker.
short.answer: der Himmel, der Herd.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

short.q: Explain how the adjective "windig" is made from the noun "Wind". Give one more example.
short.answer: Add -ig to the noun: Wind + -ig = windig. Another example: Sonne + -ig = sonnig.
short.working: 1 mark for the rule, 1 mark for the example.

short.q: Write the German words with their articles for: sun, cloud, rain, snow.
short.answer: die Sonne, die Wolke, der Regen, der Schnee.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.
